title: The Measure of Cosmic Time and the Final Dissolution
description: A meditation on the measure of cosmic time, contrasting the countable, bounded ages of natural process (silver, sand, wreaths, rivers) with the unmeasurable Father and Mother of Life in the hidden storehouses. Hyle passes slowly through her five elements → trees → fruits → five worlds, against the simultaneous depicting of the Great Builder, Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Virgin of Light, and Pillar of Glory — culminating in the four-fold sequence of war, building, standing, and the 1468-year fire of release.
